aboutMe.p1: Hello! My name is Juan Mayorquín, but my friends call me "Mayo"! Since I was 5 years old, when I got my first computer, video games were my first passion. But soon, I found myself exploring the world of programming — starting with Scratch, then Java, and eventually finding my calling in web development and data analysis.
aboutMe.p2: My professional journey has taken me from building a custom order management system for a family business to engineering enterprise-grade automation platforms at Alorica, where I reduced reporting time by 60% and built Power BI dashboards consumed by team leadership every week. I'm passionate about continuous learning and currently pursuing a Big Data Analysis specialization.
aboutMe.p3: I believe that skills acquired in one area always enrich another. Outside of coding, I enjoy reading, photography, and I'm a big Formula 1 fan — Lando Norris is my guy. My philosophy: things well done look good.
